Res.Caption: Charge Code Amount
Res.FullDescription: Enter the charge code amount and currency.

Res.Caption: Code
Res.FullDescription: Select the charge code type related to the commercial invoice to consider in valuation. Example: A CIF Invoice, requires OFT and ONS charge codes to correctly value goods for customs purposes.

Res.Caption: Distribute By
Res.FullDescription: Indicates how the system should distribute this charge code amount. Default is by Value, but can be by Value, Weight, Volume or Invoice Quantity. Note: When you select a distribution method, ensure the required data has been entered for the related invoice line in the invoice lines tab (Value, Weight, Volume, Invoice Quantity).

Res.Caption: Pay Type
Res.FullDescription: Indicate if the charge is prepaid or collect.
